description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Revoke an API key

Revokes one of your API keys: it stops working at once but stays in `list_api_keys`, marked as revoked. Use `delete_api_key` instead to remove it from the list for good. A revoked key cannot be turned on again; a new key is made in the developer portal. Only keys made in the developer portal or with `POST /developer/api-keys` are revoked here; the access of a connected AI app ends with `disconnect_ai_app`. `id` comes from `list_api_keys`. 404 when no such key of yours exists.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: revoke_api_key
